legal.continuing: By continuing, you agree to our
legal.t_intro: CutBook connects customers with barbershops to book haircuts, skip the line, and earn loyalty rewards. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to these terms.
legal.t_accounts_body: Sign in with a valid email address and provide accurate information. Only one active account is allowed per email address. You pick a role — customer, barber, or shop owner — and must only use the features that belong to your role.
legal.t_bookings_body: Booking requests must be confirmed by the shop before they are final. Please arrive on time. Cancelling less than 24 hours before your appointment or missing it (no-show) may break your visit streak at that shop.
legal.t_loyalty_body: Visits and streaks are calculated automatically from completed cuts. Each milestone reward can be redeemed once per shop. Trying to fake or manipulate visits or rewards may result in losing them.
legal.t_shops_body: Shop owners are responsible for the services, prices, working hours, and staff listed for their shop. Shops appear to customers only after approval by the CutBook team.
legal.t_region_body: The app detects your country automatically so you see barbershops near you. You can only discover and book shops within your own region.
legal.t_conduct_body: Treat barbers, owners, and other customers with respect. Do not misuse the app, try to access data that is not yours, or interfere with how it works.
legal.t_changes_body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continuing to use the app means you accept the updated terms. Questions? Reach us through the app's support channels.
legal.p_intro: Your privacy matters. This policy explains what CutBook collects and how your information is used.
legal.p_collect_body: Account details (name, username, email, phone number, profile picture), your chosen role, bookings, reviews, and loyalty activity. We also store the country detected from your device's location.
legal.p_use_body: To create and manage bookings, run loyalty programs, notify you about booking updates, keep content within your region, and provide support.
legal.p_location_body: When the app starts we use your device location once to detect your country, so you only see nearby barbershops. Your precise position is never stored — only the country code. Precise location is only used when you pick an address for your own shop.
legal.p_share_body: The barbers and owner of a shop you book with can see what they need to serve you (name, booking time, notes). We rely on trusted providers: Clerk for sign-in, Supabase for data storage, and a mapping service for addresses.
legal.p_retention_body: When you delete your account, your profile is deactivated and hidden from other users. Past bookings stay part of the shop's history but are no longer linked to an active account.
legal.p_rights_body: You can update your information in the app or delete your account at any time from Account settings. For privacy questions, contact us through the app's support channels.
